question: Is N1 limited by the operating point (fixable by rebalancing) or by representation?
answer: REPRESENTATION. E2 (class-balanced sampling) should be skipped.

pairwise_auc_retrained.note: N1 separates well from N3 (0.972) and poorly from N2 (0.772). One-vs-rest (0.766) averages these and hides the specificity - the pairwise measurement was necessary.

threshold_sweep_retrained.conclusion: No decision rule on these probabilities beats N1 F1 0.348. Rebalancing moves the operating point; the operating point is worth +0.009 on N1.

leakage_confound_resolved.note: Inherited apparent advantage of +0.084 aggregate shrinks to +0.035 on honest ground; roughly 60% of it was leakage, but a real residual gap remains (more training data: 157 vs 137 recordings).

post_hoc_prior_correction.method: divide softmax probabilities by the focal alpha used in training, then argmax

oracle_exponent_0p55.WARNING: exponent tuned on TEST - reported only as an upper bound, never to be used

post_hoc_prior_correction.conclusion: sqrt(alpha) (a principled, untuned choice) reaches macro-F1 0.6335 vs the test-tuned oracle 0.6342. The sqrt-alpha proposal is validated. Most of E1b benefit is available POST-HOC without retraining; it comes from N2 recovery (0.622 -> 0.725), not from N1 (immovable at ~0.34).

recommendations.E2_class_balanced_sampling: SKIP - threshold headroom is +0.009 on N1
recommendations.E1a_overlap_192: RUN FIRST - now the higher priority. It is the only training-side lever that could improve the representation itself, which is what binds N1.
recommendations.E1b_sqrt_alpha_focal_fix: RUN - expected kappa ~0.57, but note much is post-hoc achievable; its unique value is whether softer weighting learns better features
recommendations.E3_EOG: STRONGLY JUSTIFIED - N1-vs-N2 ranking at AUC 0.79 is the binding constraint and no decision-rule change helps
recommendations.methodology_warning: Any prior-correction exponent must be fitted on VALIDATION, never test. The g=0.55 oracle above is an upper bound only.
